paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
notes: ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda limit from Primakoff production on 12C, mass range 200-450 MeV. The y-axis is 1/Lambda in GeV^-1, where the effective coupling is g_agamma=1/Lambda. Limits are at the O(1 TeV) scale, i.e. 1/Lambda ~ 1e-3 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 7/8 (no numerical table provided); the most stringent point is ~1.5e-3 GeV^-1 near 360 MeV.
